step.cmd: In NWS, review the Returned payment AI WI:

ul.li: If additional information is required, go to step 2.
If additional information is not required, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 4.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to step 5.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the details of the conversation with the client according to the National Fact-Finding, Documentation and Retention policy.

step.cmd: Determine why the client returned the payment:

ul.li: If the client is returning the payment because the client is not entitled to the payment, go to Payment returned — Client not entitled . Payment returned — Client not entitled

If the client is requesting that the returned payment be applied to an existing OP not related to the payment being returned, go to Returned payment applied to an unconnected overpayment (OP) . Returned payment applied to an unconnected overpayment (OP)
If the client is returning the payment because the payment amount is unreadable, go to Payment returned — Amount unreadable . Payment returned — Amount unreadable
If the client is returning the payment because the name is incorrect, go to Payment returned — Name incorrect . Payment returned — Name incorrect
If the client returned the payment in error, go to Payment returned in error . Payment returned in error
If the information on file indicates that one of the payment is potentially fraudulent, go to Potentially fraudulent payment . Potentially fraudulent payment
